cohort.0: One hundred and thirty-one pregnant women with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) were hospitalized for regulation of maternal plasma glucose levels.

finding.0: The highest plasma glucose level was seen at 90 min after breakfast, 60 min after lunch, and 60 min after dinner, with the upper limit plasma glucose levels most frequently exceeded at the 90 min.
